value.rationale: The existence of natural density for square-digit happy integers is a central motivated problem. The base-three case is the first nontrivial odd base and has distinctive parity and cycle structure; the strong strict bounds separate the upper and lower densities by more than one quarter. This is a meaningful global arithmetic-dynamical result rather than a small tabulation. The finite shells are selected to satisfy the exact published density-transfer criterion, not arbitrary parameter slices.
